programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader gangvagter
programme.desc: I håb om at få mere respekt fra sine klassekammerater og ikke længere være Carusos boksepude, melder Chris sig som gangvagt.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader snedage
programme.desc: Da Chris uforvarende kommer i skole på en ”snedag”, bliver han og rektor Edward fanget sammen, indtil de kan få fat i Chris’ forældre.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader vikaren
programme.desc: En videnskabeligt anlagt vikar gør Chris’ liv til et helvede ved at forvente mere af ham end af klassekammeraterne.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader at pjække
programme.desc: Da læreren miss Morello er væk i en dag, beslutter Chris og Greg sig for at pjække og tage i biografen og se ”Ghostbusters”.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader smykketyveri
programme.desc: Da Chris forpurrer Malvos forsøg på at stjæle en guldkæde fra Vanessa, giver Malvo Chris én dag til at finde en anden halskæde, ellers må han svare for følgerne.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader DJ's
programme.desc: Da nabolagets DJ bliver anholdt under en fest, overtager Chris tjansen og viser sig at være et stort hit blandt publikum.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader baseball
programme.desc: Chris står i et dilemma, da han skal vælge mellem at tage til baseballkamp med sin far og Drew eller gå i biografen med Tasha.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader hasardspil
programme.desc: Chris bliver Bed-Stuys yndlings bookmaker, da Doc opdager, at han har talent for at forudsige sportsresultater.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader frække vittigheder
programme.desc: Efter at have smuglyttet til sine forældres comedy-plader prøver Chris nogle frække vitser af på sine klassekammerater og opdager, at evnen til at få andre til at grine er nøglen til at blive populær. Men hans lærer har et andet synspunkt på sagen.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader matematik
programme.desc: Hele Chris’ klasse regner med, at han kan lære alt om alegebra til en matematikkonkurrence, og Rochelle giver sig til selv at undervise Chris.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader sidste skoledag
programme.desc: Sidste skoledag nærmer sig med hastige skridt, og Chris beslutter sig for at tage hævn over Caruso for at have gjort de sidste to år af hans liv til et helvede.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader studievejlederen
programme.desc: Da Chris klarer sig dårligt til en eksamen sender miss Morello ham til skolens studievejleder, mr. Abbott.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Caruso
programme.desc: Uden Caruso til at opretholde skolens magtbalance og med alle dem, der prøver at overtage hans rolle, indser Chris og Greg, at de er nødt til at komme med en løsning.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader at køre
programme.desc: Alt går helt galt, da den kørekortløse Chris melder sig frivilligt til at flytte sin fars bil, men kommer til at køre bilen hele vejen til skolen i et forsøg på at imponere Tasha.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Blackie
programme.desc: Da der er indbrud i lejligheden, beslutter Julius og Rochelle sig for, at det er en god idé at få hund; noget, som Chris altid har ønsket sig.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader ungkarlehybelen
programme.desc: Da hele Chris’ familie får influenza, aftaler Rochelle og Julius med mr. Omar, at han skal passe Chris, indtil familien har det bedre.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Bed Stuy
programme.desc: For at blive noteret for en fritidsaktivitet melder Chris sig til at skrive på skoleavisen.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader overnattende gæster
programme.desc: Gregs far er ude at rejse, så Chris inviterer Greg til at bo hjemme hos ham i en uge.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader mindsteløn
programme.desc: Da Doc nægter at give Chris lønforhøjelse, får Chris et nyt arbejde på den lokale kinesiske restaurant.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader den nye dreng
programme.desc: Da en ny elev, Albert, starter på Corleone, indser Chris, at han har meget mere til fælles med Albert end blot at være de to eneste sorte elever i skolen.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Kwanzaa
programme.desc: Juleferien nærmer sig, og Chris’ ferieglæde bliver til feriedepression, da hans lærer, miss Morello, beder alle eleverne om at gøre en god gerning i juleferien.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader transportmyndighederne
programme.desc: Chris og hans familie beslutter sig for at tage en tur til Syden for at deltage i begravelsen af en af Julius’ fjerne slægtninge.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader slemme drenge
programme.desc: Da Chris opdager, at hans flamme, Tasha, elsker ”slemme drenge”, beslutter han sig for at lægge den ”flinke fyr” på hylden og vinde sin drømmepiges hjerte.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader det første kys
programme.desc: Da Chris hører, at Tasha tager til fester, hvor man leger flaskeleg, prøver han at få en invitation til næste fest, så han endelig kan få sit første kys.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader påske
programme.desc: Da Tasha slår op med sin kæreste, træder Chris gerne til for at eskortere hende til påskekonkurrencen, men først skal han finde ud af, hvordan han kan være to steder på én gang, uden at hans mor opdager det.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Gretzky
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at holde sin bror væk fra ballade siger Chris modvilligt ja til at pjække fra skole og tage med Drew ud på en mission for at finde hans idol, ishockeyspilleren Wayne Gretzky.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader BFD
programme.desc: Chris er så desperat for at skaffe penge til en koncert med Run DMC, at han griber muligheden for at ansøge om mr. Omars Black Funeral Directors’ (BFD) stipendium.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader eksfangerne
programme.desc: Chris forsøger at hjælpe Malvo, en vaneforbryder, som lige er blevet løsladt fra fængslet, med at ændre sit liv ved at gå tilbage til high school.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Jordens dag
programme.desc: Chris skal finde på et skoleprojekt til Jordens dag, så han indsamler tomme dåser i den tro, at det vil blive en let opgave, som Julius kan hjælpe ham med.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader at være cool

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fresh Heir
programme.desc: Lives changed in the 20 years following an unsolved murder, and so did forensic science. In time, a high-powered microscope and DNA profiling revealed a clue no one had seen before.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Will
programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder. A phone number written on a previous page left a lasting impression, which helped to convict.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Head Games
programme.desc: A young couple decided to celebrate their first wedding anniversary with a camping trip to Mount Hood. During the trip, the husband was shot and killed. Later, his wife told two different versions of the events which led to his death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Dangerq
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Speck of Evidence
programme.desc: On September 17, 1984, in a suburb of Tucson, Arizona, eight-year-old Vicki Hoskins left home on her pink bicycle to mail a letter for her mother. She never returned, but her slightly damaged bicycle was found nearby.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Beaten by a Hair
programme.desc: In 1992, Laura Houghteling disappeared from her Bethesda home and was never seen again. Forensic scientists use evidence from her bedroom to direct police to a prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insulated Evidence
programme.desc: It's usually easy to determine how a criminal entered the crime scene. But in this case, it looked as if the killer vanished into thin air ? and perhaps he had.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Talking Skull
programme.desc: In 1987, a human skull and some bones were discovered at a Boy Scout Camp near Farmington, Missouri. Facial reconstruction aids the investigators in this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shopping Spreeq
programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Common Thread
programme.desc: After 10 bodies turn up in Florida, one victim — 17-year-old Lisa McVey — is abducted but released. She leads police to the perpertrator, Bobbie Joe Long.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: A woman who was known to have suffered from depression apparently took her own life. But her sister told police that, a year before her death, she said if anything were to happen to her there would be a note in the china cabinet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoe-In For Murder
programme.desc: On May 12, 1994, Crystal Perry was viciously murdered in her home in Bridgton, Maine. Michael Hutchinson, 32, was later found guilty in the slaying.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hot on the Trail
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: With Every Breath
programme.desc: Young Navajos in the Southwest were dying at an alarming rate. The tribe's medicine men provided investigators with a critical clue that would lead halfway around the world to a most unlikely killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Blood
programme.desc: In rural Canada, Dr. John Schneeberger is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting one of his female patients and his step daughter. DNA tests demonstrate that the doctor is innocent, but the patient insists that he sedated and raped her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freedom Fighter
programme.desc: After the suspect was convicted of arson and murder, he maintained his innocence. He turned to law books in the prison library and set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing in Time
programme.desc: A woman is reported missing after a fight with her husband. Police suspect a man who reported a fire in his car. Two tiny drops of blood are found in the interior. Finally, a tiny clue inside the suspect's watchband helps solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hand Delivered
programme.desc: In 1995, San Diego police are baffled by a pair of hands found in a dumpster. Through further investigation, they determine that the hands are those of missing person Don Hardin.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Live Wire
programme.desc: A bomb, constructed to cause as much damage as possible, kills a victim with deadly force and flame. When a painstaking search yields some tiny clues, police are able to identify the killer as surely as if he'd signed them.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Fog
programme.desc: It was the single most deadly automobile accident in American history. Almost a hundred vehicles were involved, twelve people died and more than fifty people were injured. And it happened along a stretch of highway long known for dense, thick fog.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder on the Menu
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends and coworkers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Logged
programme.desc: In 1989, the dead bodies of Joan Rogers and her two teenage daughters were found floating in Tampa Bay.

programme.desc: When police find the body of 11-year-old Krista Harrison, there are few clues to the killer's identity. But authorities are intrigued by unusual orange fibers embedded in clothing found near the victim.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Watchful Eye
programme.desc: On May 20, 2001, Carrie Nelson was beaten to death while working alone in a park office. The case went unsolved for six years. Finally, police found a match with DNA samples gathered from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Yes, In Deed
programme.desc: It was a tragic twist of fate. Just days after a woman sold her home and moved to a modest trailer, a fire took both the trailer and her life. But the autopsy proved this was no accident.

programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Der er så småt en ny alliance under opsejling på rødt hold, og der lægges lystigt planer før aftenens nominering. Men én af alliancens medlemmer bliver dog ikke involveret i aftenens planer.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: De to nominerede skal som så ofte før møde Adam i Fristelsernes Kammer for at få afsløret, hvilke vanvittige udfordringer han har oppe i ærmet til dem.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Det er en stille morgen i villaen. Stemningen er trykket, især af villaens beboere har det svært efter sidste uges udstemning.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Dagen står i gamblingens tegn, da to af husets mere risikovillige deltagere sendes i Fristelsernes Kammer for at blive testet på deres spillelyst.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Det er en dag, der står i balladens tegn. På rødt hold er den genoprettede ro så småt ved at gå fløjten - igen. Men de kan dog blive enige på holdet om, hvem de helst ser forlade villaen i denne uge.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Adam er i sit vittige hjørne, da han møder de to nominerede i Fristelsernes Kammer.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Villaens beboere bliver overrasket af ikke bare én, men hele to nye deltagere. Der flytter nemlig et kærestepar ind.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Mens et noget umage par er på en intimdate i luksuriøse omgivelser, bruger deres bedre halvdele tiden på at flirte med hinanden hjemme i villaen.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: På rødt hold er der utilfredshed med en holdkammerat, efter hun i går takkede ja til en af Adams fristelser. Men holdet er dog langt fra overbevist om, hvem de skal nominere til aftenens Retssal.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Dagens hævnudfordringer pirker begge alvorligt til de nomineredes fobier, og det sætter gang i spekulationerne om, hvorvidt de kan og tør tage udfordringen op.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: En ny pige ankommer til villaen, men denne gang er det hverken høje hæle eller dyre kjoler, Adam frister med. Det er derimod en fordel i spillet, der kan vise sig at blive dyrebar for den nye deltager.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Fristelsernes Kammer skal vise sig at blive en mere end hård omgang for de to udvalgte.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: På rødt hold tager planerne om at få holdets stærke dame smidt ud for alvor fat. Men de snedige holdkammerater har måske lidt for travlt med at lægge de skumle planer for, hvordan de skal få hende ud.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Denne uge har på mange måder stået i venskabernes tegn. Gamle venner er vendt tilbage til villaen. Nye har plantet knive i hinandens rygge. Og i dag er ikke anderledes.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Der er skidt stemning på rødt hold. Gruppens stærke dame er nedtrykt og bitter, efter de andre forsøgte sig med en kniv i ryggen på hende i sidste uge.

programme.title: iCarly: Halloween-forskrækkelser
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie sender iCarly fra en lejlighed, som det siges at spøge i. Da der begynder at ske underlige ting begynder vennerne også at frygte, at spøgelsesrygterne er sande.

programme.title: iCarly: Lad der angres

programme.title: iCarly: Så er der eftersidning
programme.desc: Sam må sidde efter den aften iCarly holder sin 50. netvideosending. Carly og Freddie kan ikke gøre, som de plejer, så de prøver, så godt de kan, at få eftersidning, så de kan sende fra skolebænken med Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi sælger tech-foots!
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie bliver inviteret til Dakas hovedkvarter, der de bliver tilbudt en stor pengesum for at reklamere for Dakas nye sko, Tech-foden, på iCarly. Men det viser sig, at skoene er forfærdelige.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg siger ikke et ord
programme.desc: Carly får en B i historieprøven, hvor hun burde have fået A. Sam, som griber chancen til sit ugentlige møde med rektor Franklin, forandrer Carlys karakter på computeren og overrasker hende med et A.

programme.title: iCarly: TV reddet af iCarly
programme.desc: En kendt producer vil lave iCarly om til et tv-program. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie bliver helt fortvivlede, når de hører om alle de store forandringer, som produceren vil foretage.

programme.title: iCarly: En kæreste for meget
programme.desc: Sam får en kæreste og de to bliver uadskillelige. Men da forholdet begynder at få følger for iCarly, bliver Carly og Freddie klar over, at de må gøre noget.

programme.title: iCarly: Detektivspire
programme.desc: Efter at have set et klip af iCarly, hvor en mand sælger illegale piratvideoer, bestemmer to detektiver sig for at bruge Carly og Spencers loft til overvågning.

programme.title: iCarly: Skoleskift i luften
programme.desc: Carly får at vide, at hun får mulighed for at få et fuldt stipendium til en privat eliteskole pga. netshowet. Skolen er Briarwood. Carly er i tvivl, men Sam og Freddie ved, at de må få hende til at gå efter det.

programme.title: iCarly: Fægtemesteren
programme.desc: Freddie trænger til lidt mandetid, så han slår sig sammen med Spencer for at træne fægtning. Freddie er et naturtalent, men tingene bliver indviklede, når Spencer får ham med i en kamp mod den utrolige Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: En date til mig!
programme.desc: Når deres ven Gibby er for genert til at invitere en pige ud, som han kan lide, bestemmer vennerne sig for at få ham og hans flamme til deltagere i et "iWin A Date" indslag på deres netvideoshow.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg så ham først!
programme.desc: Da Carly og Sam viser interesse i den samme fyr, lover de, at han ikke skal komme imellem dem. Men det er svært, og når de kæmper om hans opmærksomhed, bliver deres venskab sat på prøve.

programme.title: iCarly: Træk i nødbremsen
programme.desc: Carly må træde til, når Spencer bliver afhængig af et videospil. Sam snører Freddie til at tro, at han bliver forfulgt af uheld, når han nægter at sende et kædebrev videre.

programme.title: iCarly: I dyb gæld
programme.desc: Sam bliver fornærmet, når Freddie beskylder hende for ikke at betale ham og Carly nogle af de penge tilbage, som hun konstant låner. Sam prøver ihærdigt at betale dem tilbage - hun finder ligefrem et job.

programme.title: iCarly: Lewberts uheldige dag
programme.desc: En 'Dril Lewbert'-sketch går helt skævt og skader Carlys irriterende dørmand. Slænget plejer ham, indtil Freddies mor tager over. Men da kærligheden begynder at blomstre, må de sætte en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Tærtemysteriet
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Spencer tager Freddie med til deres yndlingskonditori, finder de ud af, at forpagteren er død. Men endnu værre er, hans opskrifter er måske gået tabt for evigt.

programme.title: iCarly: En anderledes jul
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at pifte julen op med et utraditionelt træ, kommer Spencer til at sætte ild til alle Carlys gaver. Fortvivlet ønsker hun, at hun havde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Det første kys
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortælle Carly, at han aldrig har kysset en pige, og afslører hans hemmelighed på netshowet. Gibby og Carly træner Spencer til udtagelser for det lokale professionelle fodboldhold.

programme.title: iCarly: Hvem vil have en bil?
programme.desc: Slænget kører en konkurrence på iCarly, og præmien er en ny til fra en lokal forhandler. Da Nevel vinder, opdager børnene, at forhandleren ikke kendte noget til konkurrencen eller bilen, de skulle give væk.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg møder Fred
programme.desc: Freddie siger offentligt, at han ikke er en fan af internetsensationen Fred, og får Fred til at meddele, at han holder op med at lave sine videoer. Hans fans bliver rasende over, at Freddie fik stoppet de populære videoer.

programme.title: iCarly: Et perfekt match

programme.title: Key & Peele: Obama College Years
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan befinder sig pludselig i en genopførsel af Borgerkrigen, Jesus møder en farlig alfons, og vi får set præsident Barack Obama de første år på college.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Power of Wings
programme.desc: Inkluderer sketcher hvor Keegan og Jordan aflytter hvide kvinder, der elsker sorte mænd, Wendell laver en musikvideo, og Kareem og Jahar går i fitnesscenteret.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Meegan & Andre Break Up
programme.desc: To venner kommer i klammeri på en klub, Meegan og André har en seriøs samtale, en rapper går fra et interview, Conrad flyver business class og Keegan har et nyt overskæg.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Old Ladies And Satan
programme.desc: To gamle damer slås mod Satan, ting går galt når en mand vil købe en ny madras og gæsterne på en klub tvinges til at se sandheden om sig selv.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass: In Recovery
programme.desc: En baseballspiller kæmper mod sin afhængighed af at klaske røv, en mafioso tager hævn og Steve Urkel driver en mand til vanvid.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Soul Food
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan diskuterer, hvem der er mest sort og når man er den eneste sorte fyr til en fest. Sketches inkluderer Tea Party, der opdager et nyt håb, hærens hververe, der tænker anderledes, og Bobby McFerrin, der dyster mod Michael Winslow.

programme.title: Key & Peele
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan har en flickerkamp og en MMA-fighter går for vidt, når han disser modstanderen. Andre sketches inkluderer en bryllupsgæst, der vil være dj og spille 'klassiske' numre.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Detective
programme.desc: En respekteret kriminalbetjent, ekspert i sexforbrydelser, bruger ukonventionelle metoder for at løse en sag, en actionhelt redder sin kæreste og en ansat i en forretning med yoghurtis tester for mange vareprøver.

programme.title: Key & Peele: MC Mom
programme.desc: En gangster deltager i et skuddrama, en mor skriver en sang til sin søn, to bondefangere konkurrerer, Big Boi møder André 3000 og to fyre kommer ud for et biluheld.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The End
programme.desc: Ray Parker Jr. har nogle nye sange, en mand kan ikke lade være med at sige 'deez nuts', Keegan må ringe til 112 og en ung mand lærer om Negrotown.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Michael Jackson Halloween
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan fejrer Halloween ved at flygte fra racistiske zombier, skuespillerne i 'Human Centipede' har en skræmmende genforening, og vi besøger en folkeskole for troldmænd med problemer.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sexy Vampires
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en uhyggelig asiatisk spøgelsesbofælle, fyrene ser på den lyse side af tortur og Keegan oplever et hus fyldt med sexede vampyrer.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer at fyrene har en dårlig Skype-forbindelse, en Django Unchained-slavekamp og en baseballspiller, der klasker røv for meget.

programme.title: Key & Peele: East West Bowl #2
programme.desc: Sketcherne inkluderr en introduktion af de nyeste East/West Bowl-spillere, udlejer-Devon ransager Jordans lejlighed, og Jordan bliver stødt af en overseksuel kollega.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Hollywood Sequel Doctor
programme.desc: En kildeleg mellem to venner bliver mærkelig, forfattere brainstormer til 'Gremlins 2', to bøller mistænker deres ven for at stjæle og Keegan og Jorden diskuterer Afrika til en fest.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1204

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1205

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1206

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1208

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1209

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Piger, der opfører sig som piger
programme.desc: Gianni vidste, at han var Alondras første, men efter Tami afslører sandheden, så kan han blive hendes sidste.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Du må løbe hurtigere end det, Ken
programme.desc: Caught In The Act: Unfaithfuls vært Tami Roman hjælper urolige elskere med at tage deres utro partnere på fersk gerning.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Han har ikke engang en bil.
programme.desc: R&B-kunstneren Marvin beder Tami om hjælp. Han mistænker, at hans kæreste, Tashi, danser til en ny rytme.

programme.title: Storytellers: Storytellers: No Doubt
programme.desc: Sangene inkluderer: "Don't Speak "Ex-Girlfriend" "Just A Girl" "Simple Kind of Life" "Sunday Morning" og "Trapped In A Box".

programme.title: Ink Master: OGs vs. Young Guns
programme.desc: I sæsonfinalen løfter de tre finalister sløret for deres Master Canvas-tatoveringer.

programme.title: Ink Master: Shop Wars: Ild & vand
programme.desc: I sæsonpremieren er tatoveringskunst en holdsport.

programme.title: Ink Master Redemption: Redemption: Coach Cleen
programme.desc: Tatovørerne Ashley Velazquez og Tim Lees er tilbage efter forløsning. Kan fanfavorit Cleen Rock One hjælpe dem med at sluge stoltheden og bevare roen?

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Jasmine og Mike
programme.desc: Amr. dokumentarserie

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Cassie og Steve
programme.desc: Nev og Max har rejst landet rundt og bragt par sammen. Tjek et par af deres pitstop undervejs.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Aaliyah & Alicia
programme.desc: Aaliyah har delt sine problemer med hendes første kæreste, Alicia. Selv om de ikke bor langt fra hinanden, nægter Alicia at mødes med Aaliyah.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Tony & Tiana
programme.desc: Tony mødte Tiana på Facebook for to år siden og blev vild med hende. Men store røde flag sendte ham til Nev og Kamie for at få hjælp.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: John & Kelsey
programme.desc: John er parat til at forlade Detroit, men en ting holder ham tilbage: Kelsey. De har kun chattet sammen på nettet, men John er sikker på.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta: Ufornuft & fordom
programme.desc: Joc overvejer at droppe Spices album. så han kan fokusere på sit bryllup. Amy går efter Bambis eks.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Caught In The Act: Utro
programme.desc: Jecarah får Tami til at undersøge, om forplantningspresset skræmmer Ikenna væk... eller trækker nogen ham ind til sig?

programme.title: Ghosted: Love Gone Missing: Momma's Boy
programme.desc: Naimah og Maher var klassens klovne, der straks blev BFF. Da Naimah gik ind i lufvåbnet, løb venskabet ud i sandet. Naimah sendte e-mails til Maher.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Han hun en anden lejlighed?
programme.desc: I mere end fire år har Gierra's datet Shay, der er natklubpromotor. Gierra vil gerne starte en familie.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Bestilte nogen en Gary Beadle?
programme.desc: Ricci tager en snak med Kyle for at diskutere uvenskabet og Sophie og Jordan ankommer til villaen og spreder positiv stemning.

programme.title: The Challenge All Stars: Rivaler på stjernejagt
programme.desc: Finalen nærmer sig, og de tre hold uden en stjerne vil gøre alt for at få en. Et hold frygter at miste deres stjerne i elimineringen.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Nina Agdal LXIV
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness svinger Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Nina Agdal løs i Hængekøjehelvede.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Nina Agdal LXV
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness får Rob og Steelo besøg af Nina Agdal, som afslører, hun er knallertikon i Knallertdronninger.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Nina Agdal LXVI
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness tager Rob, Steelo og Nina Agdal på banen for at blive Pickleboldet.

programme.title: Storytellers: Storytellers: Goo Goo Dolls
programme.desc: Sangene inkluderer: "Name;" "Slide;" "Here is Gone;" "Iris;" "Black Balloon;" "Big Machine;" "What a Scene;" "Broadway" og "Lucky Star".

programme.desc: Komedieserie. Charlie forsøger at overtale Judiths skilsmisse-støttegruppe til fortsat at lade Jake tilbringe weekender hos ham

programme.title: Seinfeld: The Stakeout
programme.desc: Elaine tager Jerry med til en fest, hvor han møder en kvinde. Han kender ikke hendes navn, men han vil gerne mødes med hende igen.

programme.title: Seinfeld: The Robbery
programme.desc: Da Jerry er væk bliver hans lejlighed plyndret. Lejligheden, som George viser ham, er imidlertid også en lejlighed.

programme.title: Seinfeld: Male Unbonding
programme.desc: Da han indser, at han ikke længere har noget tilfælles med den omklamrende og belastende barndomsven, grubler Jerry over en plan.

programme.title: Seinfeld: The Stock Tip
programme.desc: Jerry og George får noget insiderviden, der giver dem håb for en ny aktie. Elaine er allergisk over for sin kærestes katte.

programme.title: Spin City: The Mayor With Two Brains

programme.title: Spin City: Wall Street
programme.desc: James beslutter sig på at træde ind på aktiemarkedet, og borgmesteren leger med en ny actionfigur-dukke.

programme.title: Spin City: Klumageddon - Part 1
programme.desc: Mikes forhold til Nikki sættes på prøve, da supermodellen Heidi Klum vender tilbage.

programme.desc: Mikes forsøg på at redde forholdet med Nikki kompliceres af supermdellen Heidi Klum, da han indvikles i borgmesterens seneste romantiske krise.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory: The proton resurgence

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory: The love spell potential

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory: The bon voyage reaction

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Victor Fog, Mads Dyhr og Håb taler om kemi, venskab og ego i et godt collab. De deler - helt ærligt - erfaringer og tanker om deres nomineringer, før de slås om at få hinanden til at grine og undgå en frygtet straf.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Malle Riemer og Malika Olsen taler - helt ærligt - om at bruge deres platform til at gøre en forskel, deres nominering og drømme for fremtiden. Til slut bliver alvoren afløst af æggeløbs-konkurrence og en uforudsigelig straf.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Mads Frandsen og Fishingbrødrene taler - helt ærligt - om at gå all-in på en særlig interesse og gøre niche-content levende for mange. De deler vilde idéer, store drømme og nomineringerne - før vand, eddike og bluffet sætter smagsløgene på prøve.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.sub-title: Mia Thim, Mads Kolle & Marie Macho
programme.desc: Marie Macho, Mia Thim og Mads Kolle taler - helt ærligt - om drømmen, gennembruddet og livet som upcoming creators. De deler modgang, ambitioner og deres nomineringer - inden ærligheden bliver sat på prøve i den nervepirrende leg 'Sand eller vand'.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Kenderdudet og Peddey ser tilbage på deres lange creator-liv og taler - helt ærligt - om at forblive relevante i en branche i forandring. Bagefter bliver det ekstra varmt, når de presses til at afsløre hemmeligheder i 'Den varme sommerstol'.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 310
programme.desc: Et træt sommerhus i Geilos vinterparadis med udsigt over det fantastiske Hallingskarvet. Huset skal have et solidt løft, fornyet køkkenet og udvidet stuen.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 401
programme.desc: Langt ude i havgabet uden for Helgelands kyst i Norge, finder du den lille ø Myken. Her skal teamet renovere et 100 år gammelt fyr.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 402
programme.desc: Et ubeboeligt mekanisk værksted forvandles til et moderne og industrielt sommerhus helt ud over det sædvanlige! Det endelige resultat er måske den største forvandling, de nogensinde har været med til.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 403
programme.desc: I dag skal fyrene istandsætte en gammel, slidt hytte med panoramaudsigt over den fantastisk flotte Geirangerfjord.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 404
programme.desc: På Norges vestligste øgruppe, Utvær, er en smuk hytte, der desperat har brug for hjælp fra Halvor og teamet. Der skal ske en større forvandling, både ude og inde.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 405
programme.desc: I dette afsnit blander teamet elementer fra områder og rum udendørs og indendørs. Det bliver en hård start, da Gustav ringer til Halvor og siger, at han bliver nødt til at blive hjemme grundet sygdom.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 406
programme.desc: På en kort bådtur uden for Kristiansand finder drengene en lille perle af en hytte, med kun en spytklat over til Danmark. Ole har meget særlige planer for den udvendige del af hytten.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 407
programme.desc: Teamet skal være ekstra kreative i en hytte ved den skønne vinterdestination Sjusjøen, hvor roer og langrendsløber Birgit Skarstein og hendes sambo Martin har et trænings- og ferieparadis.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 408
programme.desc: Denne gang skal to hytter dybt inde i Finnskogen renoveres. Den ene er minimalistisk og nordisk, mens den anden er traditionel og hyggelig.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 409
programme.desc: Teamet tager til Telemarks største sø, Møsvatn. De skal renovere en hytte, og Halvor bruger næsten 100 liter sort maling ude og inde, men alligevel ender hytten med en blød og behagelig atmosfære.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 410
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit rejser teamet til Harstad for at renovere en hytte til Den Norske Turistforening. Det bliver et meget særligt projekt, der tager flere uger.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 501
programme.desc: For første gang i Skønne ombygninger rejser fyrene til udlandet, nemlig ned til de franske vinstokke. Her renoverer de et charmerende sommerhus for et norsk par, i hjertet af Provence.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 502
programme.desc: I andet afsnit af sæsonen rejser vores renoveringsgenier til en hytte uden for den idylliske by Lillesand. Det bliver en uforglemmelig uge med et kreativt og overraskende resultat.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 503
programme.desc: Teamet har aldrig før haft at gøre med en uidentificerbar flyvende genstand, men én gang skal jo være den første. Hold på hat og briller, for deres projekt i Nevlunghavn bliver en udenjordisk oplevelse.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 504
programme.desc: Denne uge påbegynder teamet en renovering, som ejerne ikke har efterspurgt. De tilbringer seks dage ved Værøy fyr uden for Lofoten på en opgave, som ejerne tror vil tage fem til seks år.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 505
programme.desc: En gammel bjælkehytte på en ø midt i Nordmarka får en større opgradering og bliver tilpasset nye tider.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 506
programme.desc: En gammel fiskemodtagelse på Sandøya skal have en ansigtsløftning, og de vilde kræfter fra Atlanterhavet kommer til at spille en stor rolle.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 507
programme.desc: Denne gang er teamet i gang med en traditionel hytte omgivet af mosegrønt terræn. Gustav bygger en eventyrlig vildmarksspa, mens Ole bygger borde af flere hundrede år gammelt materiale.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 508
programme.desc: En gammel folkehøjskolehytte bliver forvandlet til en familiehytte, og aldrig før har teamet foretaget en så drastisk omlægning af grundplanen.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 509
programme.desc: En gammel gård fra 1800-tallet i Trøndelag skal renoveres og moderniseres men ikke miste sin sjæl og charme. Det betyder, at Ole skal få et stykke nyt træ til at se gammelt ud.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 510
programme.desc: Ole, Gustav og Halvor renoverer hver deres fiskerhytte på Træna i Nordland. Her kommer deres konkurrencegener op til overfladen, da ejerne skal vælge, hvilken fiskerhytte de bedst kan lide.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.sub-title: One Jeannie Beats Four Of A Kind
programme.desc: Luck for Tony and Roger -- Jeannie proves to be one-of-a-kind.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.desc: Tony's unauthorized chili is "hot" not because of the sauce, but because of his conniving cousin Arvel.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: Star Trek I: The Motion Picture
programme.sub-title: Star Trek I: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: Da et uidentificeret objekt ødelægger de tre mægtige Klingon-krydsere vender kaptajn James T. Kirk (William Shatner) tilbage til det nyligt ombyggede U.S.S. Enterprise(tm) for at overtage kommandoen.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.sub-title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Det er 2200-tallet. Føderationens U.S.S. Enterprise er på en træingsopgave, og admiral James T. Kirk (William Shatner) har forsonet sig med, at inspektionen kan blive den sidste rumrejse i hans karriere. Men Khan er tilbage.

programme.title: Star Trek III: Jagten På Spock
programme.sub-title: Star Trek III: Jagten På Spock
programme.desc: Admiral Kirks sejr over Khan og oprettelsen af Genesis-planeten er tomme sejre. Spock er død, og McCoy bliver på uforklarlig vis drevet til vanvid. Så giver et overraskende besøg af Sarek, Spocks far, en opsigtsvækkende åbenbaring..

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.sub-title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Det er det 23. århundrede, og en rumvæsenmagt fordamper havene. For at redde menneskeheden må Kirk og hans besætning rejse tilbage til 1986, hvor de finder en verden fuld af Punk, Pizza og byttebusser, er vildfremmed for dem!

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.sub-title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Besætningen om bord på føderations stjerneskib Enterprise beordres til Nimbus III, den intergalaktiske fredsplanet. De må kun forhandle i en sag om kidnapning for blot at finde ud af, at kidnapperen er i familie med Spock.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.sub-title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Efter flere års krig forbereder føderationen og Klingon-imperiet en fredskonference, da et Klingon-skib næsten bliver ødelagt af et tilsyneladende angreb fra Enterprise. De to verdener ruster sig til deres endelige kamp.

programme.title: Star Trek VII: Generations
programme.desc: Picards eneste håb for en fremtid hviler hos Nexus...og en legendarisk kaptajn fra fortiden.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Efter en episk kamp mod borgene (cybernetisk forstærkede livsformer), følger kaptajn Picard og hans besætning borgene tilbage til 2000-tallet for at forhindre, at de ændrer jordens tidslinje og den første udenjordiske kontakt.

programme.title: Star Trek IX: Insurrection
programme.desc: Fra føderationens start var hovedreglen klar. Ingen Starfleet-ekspedition må forstyrre den naturlige udvikling af andre civilisationer. Men Picard konfronteres nu med ordrer, der går imod den regel.

programme.title: Star Trek IX: Insurrection
programme.desc: Fra føderationens start var hovedreglen klar. Ingen Starfleet-ekspedition må forstyrre den naturlige udvikling af andre civilisationer. Men Picard konfronteres nu med ordrer, der går imod den regel.

programme.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
programme.desc: Kursen er sat mod en galakse med action og eventyr uden lige, mens kaptajn Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) og hans stjerneskibsbesætning kæmper mod en farlig modstander, som har en overraskende forbindelse til Picard!
